summary_1line: Bhishma explains that disciplined silent mantra recitation, combined with renunciation and meditation, leads the practitioner toward absorption in Brahman and liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: An ascetic sits alone on kusa grass, surrounded by the same sacred blades, eyes closed while silently reciting the Gayatri and meditating on Brahman.
A renunciate with matted hair bound by kusa grass sits motionless in solitude, withdrawing his mind from the world as the forest lies quiet around him.
